Metadata.siteDescription: Author rubrics, run them against your AI outputs, and ship with confidence.

CookieConsent.body: Strictly-necessary cookies keep you signed in and are always on. With your consent we also use analytics cookies to understand product usage and diagnose errors. See our <notice>Privacy & Cookie Notice</notice>.

Home.heroTitle: Maximize your AI <hl>results</hl>. Take every project to the next level.
Home.heroSubtitle: Stop guessing which prompt works. Baseline automatically optimizes your AI workflows so you get reliable, high-quality results every time. No engineering required.
Home.heroReassurance: No credit card required · No engineering required · Results in minutes
Home.resultCaption: Weighted across {criteria} Criteria · {rows} Eval Run Rows
Home.problemLead: You change a word, read a couple of answers, and hope it holds. There's no number, no proof, and no way to know what it cost everyone else.
Home.pain1Title: You can't tell good from lucky
Home.pain1Body: One nice answer in the demo says nothing about the next thousand.
Home.pain2Title: Every tweak is a coin flip
Home.pain2Body: Change a line, re-read by hand, repeat. Hours gone, still no proof.
Home.pain3Body: The prompt lives in one person's head. No team, no history, no baseline.
Home.loopStep2: Run it again, read a few
Home.optTitle: Take the guesswork out of prompting.
Home.optLead: Point Baseline at the result you want. It scores every version against your standards and automatically rewrites the prompt until quality climbs. You review the proof, not the guesswork.
Home.optQuote: You're no longer limited by your prompt, only by the model.
Home.step1Body: A Rubric is just your standard for "good," written in plain language and weighted by what matters most. No code.
Home.step2Body: Baseline scores your prompt on the real inputs you care about, Criterion by Criterion. You get an honest number, not a hunch.
Home.step3Body: It rewrites and re-scores on its own, keeping the version that wins on every Criterion.
Home.step4Body: You get the higher-scoring result and the receipts behind it: what changed, and why it's better.
Home.optNote: Optimization Runs are on paid plans. The free plan includes Rubrics and Eval Runs, so you can measure first and optimize when you upgrade.
Home.featTitle: A measurement instrument for your AI.
Home.featLead: Optimization is the headline. Underneath it is a full toolkit for measuring, trusting, and sharing what your AI produces.
Home.feature1Body: Baseline rewrites and re-scores your prompt until quality climbs. The guesswork, gone.
Home.feature2Body: Describe a great result in plain language. The AI judge scores it against the weighted Criteria you set. No code.
Home.feature3Body: Run your prompt against hundreds of real cases at once. Every Eval Run is reproducible and shareable.
Home.feature4Body: Set your best result as the baseline. Every future change is measured against it, so quality climbs and never quietly slips.
Home.feature5Body: Contributors and Readonly Members share one source of truth. No more prompts buried in someone's notes.
Home.feature6Body: Per-row, per-Criterion scores with the judge's reasoning. Know what improved and what to fix next.
Home.ctaSubtitle: Set your standard once. Let Baseline optimize toward it and watch your AI results climb.
Home.footerTagline: Measure, optimize, and trust your AI results without writing a line of code.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Baseline collects, uses, and protects personal data, the cookies we set, and the subprocessors we rely on.
Privacy.heading: Privacy & Cookie Notice
Privacy.whoBody: Baseline provides a platform for authoring rubrics and evaluating AI outputs. Baseline is the data controller for the personal data described here. Our governing law and place of establishment is <jur>[JURISDICTION]</jur>. If you have any questions or want to exercise your rights, contact us at <mail></mail>.
Privacy.collectAccount: Account data — your email, name, and organization memberships, so we can authenticate you and provide the service. Legal basis: performance of our contract with you.
Privacy.collectContent: Content you create — rubrics, datasets, evaluation runs, and related data you enter. Legal basis: performance of our contract with you.
Privacy.collectBilling: Billing data — subscription and payment identifiers, processed through Stripe. Legal basis: performance of our contract and compliance with legal obligations.
Privacy.collectAnalytics: Product analytics & error monitoring — usage events, device/browser information, and error reports. Legal basis: your consent, collected via the cookie banner. These are off until you accept, and you can withdraw consent at any time.
Privacy.retentionBody: We retain account and content data for as long as your account is active, and delete or anonymize it after you close your account, subject to any retention we must keep for legal, tax, or fraud-prevention reasons. Analytics data is retained according to each analytics provider's standard retention windows.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can access, correct, export, or erase your personal data. You can export your data or permanently delete your account at any time from <settings>Settings → Account</settings>. Depending on where you live, you may also have the right to restrict or object to processing, or to lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority. To make any other request, email <mail></mail>.
Privacy.cookiesIntro: We use a small number of cookies. Strictly-necessary cookies are required to run the service and are always active. Analytics cookies are only set after you accept them in the banner — you can decline without losing any functionality.
Privacy.cookiesManage: You can change your analytics choice at any time: <prefs>Manage cookie preferences</prefs>.

cookiePurpose.authToken: Keeps you signed in (Supabase authentication session).
cookiePurpose.activeOrg: Remembers which organization you're currently working in.
cookiePurpose.analyticsConsent: Remembers your cookie choice so we don't ask again.
cookiePurpose.posthog: PostHog product-analytics cookies — set only after you accept.

Privacy.subprocessorsIntro: We rely on the third-party services below to operate Baseline. Each processes personal data on our behalf under a data-processing agreement. The analytics subprocessors run only after you consent.
Privacy.transfersBody: Some of our subprocessors are located in the United States. Where personal data is transferred outside your region, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
Privacy.changesBody: We may update this notice from time to time. When we make material changes, we'll update the "last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you in the app.

editor.pickIntro: Start with a template or build your own from scratch.
editor.evalModeTooltip: Prompt / Response: evaluates single-turn interactions between one user prompt and one AI response. Conversational: evaluates multi-turn dialogue where context from prior messages matters.
editor.scenarioTooltip: Describe the context in which the AI is being evaluated — e.g. 'Customer support chat for an e-commerce platform.' This helps the LLM evaluator understand the purpose of the interaction.
editor.expectedTooltip: Describe what a high-quality AI response looks like in this scenario. The LLM evaluator uses this as its benchmark when scoring outputs.
editor.expectedPlaceholder: What does a good response look like?
editor.groundingTooltip: Reference material the LLM evaluator can consult when scoring responses — e.g. product documentation, policies, or domain knowledge. Providing this improves scoring accuracy when correct answers depend on specific facts.
editor.groundingPlaceholder: Reference material for the LLM evaluator…
editor.weightTooltip: A decimal from 0 to 1 representing this criterion's importance. All weights must sum to exactly 1.00 — e.g. two equal criteria each get 0.50.
editor.scoringStepsTooltip: Step-by-step instructions the LLM evaluator follows when scoring this criterion. More detailed steps produce more consistent, repeatable scores.

runs.selectRubricBody: Choose a rubric from the list to view its eval runs

eval.title: Run eval
eval.rubricTooltip: The rubric defines the criteria and scoring methodology for this evaluation. Select the rubric that matches the behavior you want to measure.
eval.typeTooltip: Tabular evaluation processes structured rows of user inputs and agent outputs. Each row is scored independently against the selected rubric's criteria.
eval.inputSourceTooltip: Choose how to provide the evaluation data: upload a CSV file, enter rows manually, or paste a JSON array. Each row represents one interaction to be scored.
eval.expectedOutputTooltip: The ideal or reference answer for this input. When provided, the evaluator can compare the agent's actual output against it for accuracy scoring.
eval.retrievalContextTooltip: Documents or context retrieved by a RAG system when answering the user's query. Useful for evaluating whether the agent correctly used the retrieved information.

wizard.title: New optimization run
wizard.rubricHint: The rubric scores each rollout. Its per-criterion reasoning is the textual feedback the reflection model learns from.
wizard.systemModeLegend: Choose how to provide your System
wizard.modeManagedDesc: Optimize a prompt on our managed LLM. No setup — we run and tune it for you.

wizard.modeNewDesc: Point Baseline at your own HTTP endpoint to optimize.
wizard.optModeSimpleDesc: Samples prompt variants and keeps the best. Good for narrow, well-defined tasks.
wizard.optModeReflectiveDesc: Learns from the Rubric's feedback. Best for nuanced criteria.
wizard.newConnIntro: Baseline calls your agent once per rollout. Reference each Module as {prompt} in the request body alongside {userInput}; the response path locates the agent's output. The new connection is saved and reusable.
